policies.qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM waste_bins b
  WHERE (b.id = bin_accepted_categories.bin_id)))

((status = 'verified'::text) AND (archived_at IS NULL) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM data_sources s
  WHERE ((s.id = disposal_rules.source_id) AND (s.verification_status = 'verified'::text) AND (s.archived_at IS NULL)))) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM areas a
  WHERE ((a.id = disposal_rules.area_id) AND (a.archived_at IS NULL)))) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM waste_items i
  WHERE ((i.id = disposal_rules.item_id) AND (i.status = 'published'::text) AND (i.archived_at IS NULL)))))

(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM waste_items i
  WHERE (i.id = item_materials.item_id)))

((EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM locations l
  WHERE (l.id = location_bins.location_id))) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM waste_bins b
  WHERE (b.id = location_bins.bin_id))))

((verification_status = 'verified'::text) AND (verified_at IS NOT NULL) AND (latitude IS NOT NULL) AND (longitude IS NOT NULL) AND (archived_at IS NULL) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM data_sources s
  WHERE ((s.id = locations.source_id) AND (s.verification_status = 'verified'::text) AND (s.archived_at IS NULL)))) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM areas a
  WHERE ((a.id = locations.area_id) AND (a.archived_at IS NULL)))))

(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM quizzes q
  WHERE (q.id = quiz_questions.quiz_id)))

((EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM disposal_rules r
  WHERE (r.id = rule_bins.rule_version_id))) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM waste_bins b
  WHERE (b.id = rule_bins.bin_id))))

((EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM disposal_rules r
  WHERE (r.id = rule_sources.rule_version_id))) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM data_sources s
  WHERE (s.id = rule_sources.source_id))))

((verification_status = 'verified'::text) AND (archived_at IS NULL) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM data_sources s
  WHERE ((s.id = waste_bins.source_id) AND (s.verification_status = 'verified'::text) AND (s.archived_at IS NULL)))) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM areas a
  WHERE ((a.id = waste_bins.area_id) AND (a.archived_at IS NULL)))))
